title: Agreement of the Two Parsing Steps
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers, let $a\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, let $w$ be a finite bit string, and let $v$ be a finite list of natural numbers. The transition that parses an algebraic gate from a leading $1$ in $w$ and appends its value when all referenced gates precede the current list length agrees with the transition that checks whether the word is finished or valid and, when valid, appends its computed value: both produce the same pair of residual word and value list from $(w,v)$.
hypotheses_covered: $v$ is a finite list of natural numbers
